summary: Assess vulnerabilities, prioritize remediation and report findings with structured exercises. Explore the enterprise ethical hacking course.
lede: Authorized ethical hacking helps security analysts, penetration testers and IT risk specialists assess vulnerabilities and turn evidence into actionable remediation. Learners practise defining authorized scope, applying CVSS with asset and exposure context, mapping validated findings to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and drafting risk-ranked backlogs, remediation actions and evidence-based retest criteria.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who assess, prioritize or coordinate authorized security testing and vulnerability remediation across enterprise systems. It is designed for technical practitioners and the adjacent risk and operations roles that turn findings into tracked work.
modules: Ethical Hacking Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, operating systems and basic information security concepts. Coding is not required for the stated course outcomes.
